entities.summary: Teuta, a notable figure in the history of Montenegro, associated with Illyrian & Roman Doclea (1000 BCE–168 BCE). Preceded by Illyrian Tribes & Greek Coastal Contacts. Their legacy influenced Roman defeat of Illyrian King Gentius and Roman.
